[← Back to experience](/#experience){.pf-back}

Every year, ISSEA students run a real household survey in Yaoundé. I took part twice: first as an interviewer, then as a supervisor. It taught me where survey data comes from, and how much its quality depends on the work in the field.

## Survey Supervisor · May 2025 {#supervisor}

- Supervised a team of interviewers during data collection.
- Ran consistency checks on the questionnaires as they came in.
- Validated the collected data and sent back questionnaires that needed correction.

## Survey Interviewer · May 2024 {#interviewer}

- Conducted face-to-face interviews with households for a survey on urban safety in Yaoundé.
- Followed the sampling plan and the questionnaire protocol.
